text:
Nikhil: Quick heads up — flight got delayed, need someone to take primary tonight 22:00-06:00 UTC. I'll be at the airport and may lose stable signal. Can cover a handoff at 21:30 if needed. @Jade @Priya can either of you take primary?
Jade: I can take primary 22:00-02:00 but need to hand off at 02:00. Who will be secondary for the whole window?
Priya: I can be secondary 22:00-06:00. @OncallBot can you confirm my pager is active and reachable?
OncallBot: Pager status check: Nikhil = primary (current), Priya = on-call candidate. To update rotation use `/oncall swap --from nikhil --to jade --start 22:00 --end 02:00` or run the web console: https://console.redwood/infrarota
OpsBot: Incident alert at ~21:05 UTC — embeddings-service 5xx rate spiked x4. Current primary: Nikhil. Customer-facing errors: 0. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/embeds-5xx (please read before taking primary).
Nikhil: I'm still online and will execute a canary restart now. Quick mitigation: restart embeddings canary + scale if it doesn't settle in 5m. Priya please monitor alerts while I do the restart.
Marco: If Jade takes 22:00-02:00, I can cover 02:00-06:00 as backup. Sami, you around for the 02:00 boundary in case we need a smoother handover?
Sami: I can pick up 02:00-06:00 if needed but prefer a 03:00 handover window (I have a short call at 02:15). Either way I can standby.
Jade: Plan suggestion: Jade primary 22:00-02:00. Priya secondary 22:00-06:00 (full night). Sami on primary 02:00-06:00 (flex to 03:00 if required). Marco standby for 02:00-06:00 if Sami isn't available. Nikhil please kick the rotation update when you can.
Nikhil: Executing rotation transfer now (manual CLI): `/rotations transfer --primary jade --secondary priya --start 2026-03-15T22:00Z --note "flight delay swap"`
Nikhil: Leaving the quick runbook snippet here for whoever is primary for embeds tonight:
```
- Confirm #incidents and paging targets set to primary & secondary
- Check embeddings-pool health: `curl -sS http://embed-health/metrics | jq '.error_rate'`
- If error_rate > 3x baseline -> scale pool: `infra scale pool embeds --replicas +2`
- Restart canary: `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/embed-canary`
- If >10% user-facing errors -> escalate to CS and run customer-notify playbook
- Capture a few sample request/response pairs and attach to incident thread for QA
```
OncallBot: Rotation update requested. Applying change...
OncallBot: Rotation updated — primary = Jade (effective 22:00 UTC), secondary = Priya. Pager routing updated. AuditID: RBW-2026-1003
Priya: I see the pager now and have acked OpsBot's alert. I'll monitor latency and error-rate dashboards and DM Jade a short notes pack at 21:50.
Marco: :thumbsup: I'll be on standby and can jump in if Sami can't make the 03:00 slot.
OpsBot: Update: embeddings 5xx rate trending down after canary restart. No customer-facing errors detected. Continue to monitor for next 30m.
Nikhil: Thanks all — I'll keep my laptop reachable for another 20m in case anything pops up while I finish check-in. Safe handoffs everyone :airplane:
